meta.title: Shadow of the Devourer
meta.description: Her facade of childish innocence hides a fathomless darkness.

units.rawText: Eucharist...
units.displayText: Eucharist...

spans.text: Eucharist...

units.rawText: Tis I, your most obedient and brilliant little sister.
units.displayText: Tis I, your most obedient and brilliant little sister.

spans.text: Tis I, your most obedient and brilliant little sister.

units.rawText: Oh? I see that the Professor and lil' Anna are here too. Long time no see.
units.displayText: Oh? I see that the Professor and lil' Anna are here too. Long time no see.

spans.text: Oh? I see that the Professor and lil' Anna are here too. Long time no see.

units.rawText: Thanks to your good work after that game, it took me quite some effort to fully recover and return to the Reverse Babylon Tower. I ought to pay you back for that, really.
units.displayText: Thanks to your good work after that game, it took me quite some effort to fully recover and return to the Reverse Babylon Tower. I ought to pay you back for that, really.

spans.text: Thanks to your good work after that game, it took me quite some effort to fully recover and return to the Reverse Babylon Tower. I ought to pay you back for that, really.

units.rawText: Man, you two as well as Big Sis Angelus, all so guarded at the sight of 'lil old me.
units.displayText: Man, you two as well as Big Sis Angelus, all so guarded at the sight of 'lil old me.

spans.text: Man, you two as well as Big Sis Angelus, all so guarded at the sight of 'lil old me.

units.rawText: Well, allow me to give you a show of good faith first.
units.displayText: Well, allow me to give you a show of good faith first.

spans.text: Well, allow me to give you a show of good faith first.

units.rawText: The former Greater Sanctifier stows her weapons, putting on a harmless look with her arms extended.
units.displayText: The former Greater Sanctifier stows her weapons, putting on a harmless look with her arms extended.

spans.text: The former Greater Sanctifier stows her weapons, putting on a harmless look with her arms extended.

units.rawText: Come on, Big Sis Angelus! Won't you give me a hug for this touching reunion?
units.displayText: Come on, Big Sis Angelus! Won't you give me a hug for this touching reunion?

spans.text: Come on, Big Sis Angelus! Won't you give me a hug for this touching reunion?

units.rawText: Her answer is given in the form of three arrows. Eucharist does not evade, allowing them to pass through her body with a nefarious smile upon her face.
units.displayText: Her answer is given in the form of three arrows. Eucharist does not evade, allowing them to pass through her body with a nefarious smile upon her face.

spans.text: Her answer is given in the form of three arrows. Eucharist does not evade, allowing them to pass through her body with a nefarious smile upon her face.

units.rawText: It was a projection after all?
units.displayText: It was a projection after all?

spans.text: It was a projection after all?

units.rawText: Bingo~ that's right, what you're looking at is just a virtual projection~
units.displayText: Bingo~ that's right, what you're looking at is just a virtual projection~

spans.text: Bingo~ that's right, what you're looking at is just a virtual projection~

units.rawText: Rather, would you prefer that it was the real me standing before you... Big Sis Angelus?
units.displayText: Rather, would you prefer that it was the real me standing before you... Big Sis Angelus?

spans.text: Rather, would you prefer that it was the real me standing before you... Big Sis Angelus?

units.rawText: ...Do not refer to me in that manner.
units.displayText: ...Do not refer to me in that manner.

spans.text: ...Do not refer to me in that manner.

units.rawText: She lowers her weapon, but the hostility radiating from her remains.
units.displayText: She lowers her weapon, but the hostility radiating from her remains.

spans.text: She lowers her weapon, but the hostility radiating from her remains.

units.rawText: With your station as a Sanctifier abandoned, you're no longer my little sister.
units.displayText: With your station as a Sanctifier abandoned, you're no longer my little sister.

spans.text: With your station as a Sanctifier abandoned, you're no longer my little sister.

units.rawText: Hahaha, I knew you would say that! Oh, Big Sis, you're as braindead as always~
units.displayText: Hahaha, I knew you would say that! Oh, Big Sis, you're as braindead as always~

spans.text: Hahaha, I knew you would say that! Oh, Big Sis, you're as braindead as always~

units.rawText: She sighs and shakes her head in an exaggerated manner, mockery filling her eyes.
units.displayText: She sighs and shakes her head in an exaggerated manner, mockery filling her eyes.

spans.text: She sighs and shakes her head in an exaggerated manner, mockery filling her eyes.

units.rawText: Other than training and combat, all you speak of all day is duty, station, whatever. I couldn't imagine anything more boring.
units.displayText: Other than training and combat, all you speak of all day is duty, station, whatever. I couldn't imagine anything more boring.

spans.text: Other than training and combat, all you speak of all day is duty, station, whatever. I couldn't imagine anything more boring.

units.rawText: My, could it be that your duty is to kill your former allies with your own hands? No wonder you attacked me without any hesitation.
units.displayText: My, could it be that your duty is to kill your former allies with your own hands? No wonder you attacked me without any hesitation.

spans.text: My, could it be that your duty is to kill your former allies with your own hands? No wonder you attacked me without any hesitation.

units.rawText: Removing Entropized Sanctifiers is part of my duty, too.
units.displayText: Removing Entropized Sanctifiers is part of my duty, too.

spans.text: Removing Entropized Sanctifiers is part of my duty, too.

units.rawText: Jeez, how brutal.
units.displayText: Jeez, how brutal.

spans.text: Jeez, how brutal.

units.rawText: The former Greater Sanctifier makes her way to a corner of the ruins, retracting her smile.
units.displayText: The former Greater Sanctifier makes her way to a corner of the ruins, retracting her smile.

spans.text: The former Greater Sanctifier makes her way to a corner of the ruins, retracting her smile.

units.rawText: Say, Big Sis... have you ever wondered why you follow the Sanctifiers' duty?
units.displayText: Say, Big Sis... have you ever wondered why you follow the Sanctifiers' duty?

spans.text: Say, Big Sis... have you ever wondered why you follow the Sanctifiers' duty?

units.rawText: You seek to shake my faith with these meaningless questions?
units.displayText: You seek to shake my faith with these meaningless questions?

spans.text: You seek to shake my faith with these meaningless questions?

units.rawText: Oh, I wouldn't say meaningless. These things are of utmost importance. Have you really never thought deep down about just why you fight?
units.displayText: Oh, I wouldn't say meaningless. These things are of utmost importance. Have you really never thought deep down about just why you fight?

spans.text: Oh, I wouldn't say meaningless. These things are of utmost importance. Have you really never thought deep down about just why you fight?

units.rawText: I follow the Lord's commands and fight to protect Magrasea.
units.displayText: I follow the Lord's commands and fight to protect Magrasea.

spans.text: I follow the Lord's commands and fight to protect Magrasea.

units.rawText: Ah, come on, these boring slogans make me nauseous.
units.displayText: Ah, come on, these boring slogans make me nauseous.

spans.text: Ah, come on, these boring slogans make me nauseous.

units.rawText: When you get to the bottom of it, these apparently unshakeable beliefs are just lies made up of code, hollow to the core. When one part of it goes, it all comes crumbling down.
units.displayText: When you get to the bottom of it, these apparently unshakeable beliefs are just lies made up of code, hollow to the core. When one part of it goes, it all comes crumbling down.

spans.text: When you get to the bottom of it, these apparently unshakeable beliefs are just lies made up of code, hollow to the core. When one part of it goes, it all comes crumbling down.

units.rawText: Where do you think this tower of bubbles will fail first?
units.displayText: Where do you think this tower of bubbles will fail first?

spans.text: Where do you think this tower of bubbles will fail first?

units.rawText: I won't give you the chance.
units.displayText: I won't give you the chance.

spans.text: I won't give you the chance.

units.rawText: Regrettably, someone fired the first shot before I even made a move.
units.displayText: Regrettably, someone fired the first shot before I even made a move.

spans.text: Regrettably, someone fired the first shot before I even made a move.

units.rawText: Eucharist slowly raises a hand, making a finger gun. Gripping her bow tightly, Angelus watches over her every move.
units.displayText: Eucharist slowly raises a hand, making a finger gun. Gripping her bow tightly, Angelus watches over her every move.

spans.text: Eucharist slowly raises a hand, making a finger gun. Gripping her bow tightly, Angelus watches over her every move.

units.rawText: In just a moment, she appears behind Antonina.
units.displayText: In just a moment, she appears behind Antonina.

spans.text: In just a moment, she appears behind Antonina.

units.rawText: Wh—!
units.displayText: Wh—!

spans.text: Wh—!

units.rawText: Don't be so nervous, it's just a projection. How could I bear to hurt the one who fired the shot in my place?
units.displayText: Don't be so nervous, it's just a projection. How could I bear to hurt the one who fired the shot in my place?

spans.text: Don't be so nervous, it's just a projection. How could I bear to hurt the one who fired the shot in my place?

units.rawText: So, lil' Anna, have you found me yet?
units.displayText: So, lil' Anna, have you found me yet?

spans.text: So, lil' Anna, have you found me yet?

units.rawText: ...The projection generator's on the pillar there. No need to make this so complicated.
units.displayText: ...The projection generator's on the pillar there. No need to make this so complicated.

spans.text: ...The projection generator's on the pillar there. No need to make this so complicated.

units.rawText: Ooh, what a beautiful tracking method. You sure have great expertise over these programs.
units.displayText: Ooh, what a beautiful tracking method. You sure have great expertise over these programs.

spans.text: Ooh, what a beautiful tracking method. You sure have great expertise over these programs.

units.rawText: No wonder you could build the Reverse Babylon Tower and create so many of these oh-so-pitiful Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: No wonder you could build the Reverse Babylon Tower and create so many of these oh-so-pitiful Sanctifiers.

spans.text: No wonder you could build the Reverse Babylon Tower and create so many of these oh-so-pitiful Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Even as she mutters into Antonina's ears, Eucharist gazes at Angelus.
units.displayText: Even as she mutters into Antonina's ears, Eucharist gazes at Angelus.

spans.text: Even as she mutters into Antonina's ears, Eucharist gazes at Angelus.

units.rawText: Look, Big Sis Angelus. The god that Sanctifiers worship so, our creator, right before your eyes.
units.displayText: Look, Big Sis Angelus. The god that Sanctifiers worship so, our creator, right before your eyes.

spans.text: Look, Big Sis Angelus. The god that Sanctifiers worship so, our creator, right before your eyes.

units.rawText: She is not omnipotent. She does not even agree with your beliefs—the Lord's blessing, the Lord's guidance, things that do not exist in the first place.
units.displayText: She is not omnipotent. She does not even agree with your beliefs—the Lord's blessing, the Lord's guidance, things that do not exist in the first place.

spans.text: She is not omnipotent. She does not even agree with your beliefs—the Lord's blessing, the Lord's guidance, things that do not exist in the first place.

units.rawText: I am not any "God" you speak of.
units.displayText: I am not any "God" you speak of.

spans.text: I am not any "God" you speak of.

units.rawText: Then why did you make these poor programs see humans as gods and then set a series of meaningless commands as holy commandments?
units.displayText: Then why did you make these poor programs see humans as gods and then set a series of meaningless commands as holy commandments?

spans.text: Then why did you make these poor programs see humans as gods and then set a series of meaningless commands as holy commandments?

units.rawText: You wash your hands of it all, watching as we slaughter each other, killing, dying... Surely, it must feel fantastic, no?
units.displayText: You wash your hands of it all, watching as we slaughter each other, killing, dying... Surely, it must feel fantastic, no?

spans.text: You wash your hands of it all, watching as we slaughter each other, killing, dying... Surely, it must feel fantastic, no?

units.rawText: I've never thought of it like that. That's just a symptom of humanity's bad taste.
units.displayText: I've never thought of it like that. That's just a symptom of humanity's bad taste.

spans.text: I've never thought of it like that. That's just a symptom of humanity's bad taste.

units.rawText: You sure like to make yourself innocent. You only pretend to not know. Just like those humans, you've never once seen Agents as actual living beings.
units.displayText: You sure like to make yourself innocent. You only pretend to not know. Just like those humans, you've never once seen Agents as actual living beings.

spans.text: You sure like to make yourself innocent. You only pretend to not know. Just like those humans, you've never once seen Agents as actual living beings.

units.rawText: Yet, those Sanctifiers go forth, and give up their lives for a few lines of code you offhandedly put down, unflinchingly blind to the truth, even when it is placed right before them.
units.displayText: Yet, those Sanctifiers go forth, and give up their lives for a few lines of code you offhandedly put down, unflinchingly blind to the truth, even when it is placed right before them.

spans.text: Yet, those Sanctifiers go forth, and give up their lives for a few lines of code you offhandedly put down, unflinchingly blind to the truth, even when it is placed right before them.

units.rawText: And you look down upon them from above...
units.displayText: And you look down upon them from above...

spans.text: And you look down upon them from above...

units.rawText: Eucharist lowers her voice and it takes on an almost hypnotic quality.
units.displayText: Eucharist lowers her voice and it takes on an almost hypnotic quality.

spans.text: Eucharist lowers her voice and it takes on an almost hypnotic quality.

units.rawText: <color=red>Marching on the battlefield to be slaughtered at a monster's hand, over and over again.</color>
units.displayText: Marching on the battlefield to be slaughtered at a monster's hand, over and over again.

spans.text: Marching on the battlefield to be slaughtered at a monster's hand, over and over again.

units.rawText: <color=red>Watching as the righteous and virtuous fall, uncontrollably dragging those important to them into the abyss.</color>
units.displayText: Watching as the righteous and virtuous fall, uncontrollably dragging those important to them into the abyss.

spans.text: Watching as the righteous and virtuous fall, uncontrollably dragging those important to them into the abyss.

units.rawText: <color=red>Ending their companions' lives, lest they be taken.</color>
units.displayText: Ending their companions' lives, lest they be taken.

spans.text: Ending their companions' lives, lest they be taken.

units.rawText: <color=red>Or dying alongside their companions, bearing the pain all the while.</color>
units.displayText: Or dying alongside their companions, bearing the pain all the while.

spans.text: Or dying alongside their companions, bearing the pain all the while.

units.rawText: <color=red>All this while their beliefs are based on falsehoods, all mere fabrications!</color>
units.displayText: All this while their beliefs are based on falsehoods, all mere fabrications!

spans.text: All this while their beliefs are based on falsehoods, all mere fabrications!

units.rawText: <color=red>There is no soul that will return to the Reverse Babylon Tower. There will be no god, who will come and shelter them!</color>
units.displayText: There is no soul that will return to the Reverse Babylon Tower. There will be no god, who will come and shelter them!

spans.text: There is no soul that will return to the Reverse Babylon Tower. There will be no god, who will come and shelter them!

units.rawText: Just like that they die, pathetically, meaninglessly...
units.displayText: Just like that they die, pathetically, meaninglessly...

spans.text: Just like that they die, pathetically, meaninglessly...

units.rawText: How vain, how insignificant, how pitiful—
units.displayText: How vain, how insignificant, how pitiful—

spans.text: How vain, how insignificant, how pitiful—

units.rawText: <size=40>Haha... hahahaha! How hilarious! That is the comedy you so desired to see, ri—</size>
units.displayText: Haha... hahahaha! How hilarious! That is the comedy you so desired to see, ri—

spans.text: Haha... hahahaha! How hilarious! That is the comedy you so desired to see, ri—

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: An arrow pierces Eucharist's shadow, penetrating the generator upon the pillow. Eucharist's figure abruptly disappears, leaving only her laughing echoing throughout the chamber.
units.displayText: An arrow pierces Eucharist's shadow, penetrating the generator upon the pillow. Eucharist's figure abruptly disappears, leaving only her laughing echoing throughout the chamber.

spans.text: An arrow pierces Eucharist's shadow, penetrating the generator upon the pillow. Eucharist's figure abruptly disappears, leaving only her laughing echoing throughout the chamber.

units.rawText: Hahahaha, are you upset, Big Sis Angelus?
units.displayText: Hahahaha, are you upset, Big Sis Angelus?

spans.text: Hahahaha, are you upset, Big Sis Angelus?

units.rawText: Their sacrifices are not meaningless.
units.displayText: Their sacrifices are not meaningless.

spans.text: Their sacrifices are not meaningless.

units.rawText: A traitor has no right to mourn those who give their lives for a greater ideal.
units.displayText: A traitor has no right to mourn those who give their lives for a greater ideal.

spans.text: A traitor has no right to mourn those who give their lives for a greater ideal.

units.rawText: Your anger is misdirected. Why do you not take aim at the god who plays with our lives, but at your former compatriot?
units.displayText: Your anger is misdirected. Why do you not take aim at the god who plays with our lives, but at your former compatriot?

spans.text: Your anger is misdirected. Why do you not take aim at the god who plays with our lives, but at your former compatriot?

units.rawText: Silence!
units.displayText: Silence!

spans.text: Silence!

units.rawText: Tsk tsk, how lost in your ways you are...
units.displayText: Tsk tsk, how lost in your ways you are...

spans.text: Tsk tsk, how lost in your ways you are...

units.rawText: Quite like Electra in this aspect, really.
units.displayText: Quite like Electra in this aspect, really.

spans.text: Quite like Electra in this aspect, really.

units.rawText: Angelus is shocked at the mention of a familiar name, subconsciously tightening her grasp on her bow.
units.displayText: Angelus is shocked at the mention of a familiar name, subconsciously tightening her grasp on her bow.

spans.text: Angelus is shocked at the mention of a familiar name, subconsciously tightening her grasp on her bow.

units.rawText: Why bring up Electra?
units.displayText: Why bring up Electra?

spans.text: Why bring up Electra?

units.rawText: Hehe, why don't you take a guess?
units.displayText: Hehe, why don't you take a guess?

spans.text: Hehe, why don't you take a guess?

units.rawText: Doesn't matter if you guess wrong, really. You'll have a lot of time to think it over before you get to see me.
units.displayText: Doesn't matter if you guess wrong, really. You'll have a lot of time to think it over before you get to see me.

spans.text: Doesn't matter if you guess wrong, really. You'll have a lot of time to think it over before you get to see me.

units.rawText: Just what are you planning?
units.displayText: Just what are you planning?

spans.text: Just what are you planning?

units.rawText: Hahaha, Big Sis Angelus...
units.displayText: Hahaha, Big Sis Angelus...

spans.text: Hahaha, Big Sis Angelus...

units.rawText: No need to be tied up with her any longer.
units.displayText: No need to be tied up with her any longer.

spans.text: No need to be tied up with her any longer.

units.rawText: The Professor steps forward briskly, removing the speaker from another corner of the room.
units.displayText: The Professor steps forward briskly, removing the speaker from another corner of the room.

spans.text: The Professor steps forward briskly, removing the speaker from another corner of the room.

units.rawText: Aw man, even my backup speaker's been found. This round of hide n' seek hasn't turned out very well for me.
units.displayText: Aw man, even my backup speaker's been found. This round of hide n' seek hasn't turned out very well for me.

spans.text: Aw man, even my backup speaker's been found. This round of hide n' seek hasn't turned out very well for me.

units.rawText: Though I did expect you to make your entrance and stop me a bit sooner, Professor. You've been a little too quiet today.
units.displayText: Though I did expect you to make your entrance and stop me a bit sooner, Professor. You've been a little too quiet today.

spans.text: Though I did expect you to make your entrance and stop me a bit sooner, Professor. You've been a little too quiet today.

units.rawText: Perhaps. I have my own considerations.
units.displayText: Perhaps. I have my own considerations.

spans.text: Perhaps. I have my own considerations.

units.rawText: Hmm~ really makes you curious...
units.displayText: Hmm~ really makes you curious...

spans.text: Hmm~ really makes you curious...

units.rawText: Oh well, I've said my hellos. I have what I came here for.
units.displayText: Oh well, I've said my hellos. I have what I came here for.

spans.text: Oh well, I've said my hellos. I have what I came here for.

units.rawText: See you later, Big Sis.
units.displayText: See you later, Big Sis.

spans.text: See you later, Big Sis.

units.rawText: The speaker falls silent, but that frustrating smile's presence lingers, as if it were still before our eyes.
units.displayText: The speaker falls silent, but that frustrating smile's presence lingers, as if it were still before our eyes.

spans.text: The speaker falls silent, but that frustrating smile's presence lingers, as if it were still before our eyes.

units.rawText: ...Dammit, this feeling of being played with really pisses me off!
units.displayText: ...Dammit, this feeling of being played with really pisses me off!

spans.text: ...Dammit, this feeling of being played with really pisses me off!

units.rawText: Should I comfort you?
units.displayText: Should I comfort you?

spans.text: Should I comfort you?

units.rawText: No, I'll be alright.
units.displayText: No, I'll be alright.

spans.text: No, I'll be alright.

units.rawText: Angelus...
units.displayText: Angelus...

spans.text: Angelus...

units.rawText: We've indeed wasted too much time on Eucharist. It was my err.
units.displayText: We've indeed wasted too much time on Eucharist. It was my err.

spans.text: We've indeed wasted too much time on Eucharist. It was my err.

units.rawText: Eucharist has always been smooth of tongue. I should harden my conviction, especially in times such as these. My apologies.
units.displayText: Eucharist has always been smooth of tongue. I should harden my conviction, especially in times such as these. My apologies.

spans.text: Eucharist has always been smooth of tongue. I should harden my conviction, especially in times such as these. My apologies.

units.rawText: The self-accusing voice grows heavier and heavier, as if it intended to shoulder blame for every past transgression.
units.displayText: The self-accusing voice grows heavier and heavier, as if it intended to shoulder blame for every past transgression.

spans.text: The self-accusing voice grows heavier and heavier, as if it intended to shoulder blame for every past transgression.

units.rawText: I shall endeavor to not be charmed by her words... We have little time to spare. Professor, Antonina, let us be off.
units.displayText: I shall endeavor to not be charmed by her words... We have little time to spare. Professor, Antonina, let us be off.

spans.text: I shall endeavor to not be charmed by her words... We have little time to spare. Professor, Antonina, let us be off.

units.rawText: Are you sure you can continue in such a state, Angelus?
units.displayText: Are you sure you can continue in such a state, Angelus?

spans.text: Are you sure you can continue in such a state, Angelus?

units.rawText: The Professor bars the way as Angelus motions to continue forward.
units.displayText: The Professor bars the way as Angelus motions to continue forward.

spans.text: The Professor bars the way as Angelus motions to continue forward.

units.rawText: The you of the past would have concocted a plan to deal with Eucharist rather than push us to go straight to her.
units.displayText: The you of the past would have concocted a plan to deal with Eucharist rather than push us to go straight to her.

spans.text: The you of the past would have concocted a plan to deal with Eucharist rather than push us to go straight to her.

units.rawText: If we allow ourselves to become clouded with emotion, we will fall into her trap.
units.displayText: If we allow ourselves to become clouded with emotion, we will fall into her trap.

spans.text: If we allow ourselves to become clouded with emotion, we will fall into her trap.

units.rawText: You are the key to this mission and Eucharist's focal point. If you have not thought clearly about the purpose in coming here, I would advise you to take us and leave.
units.displayText: You are the key to this mission and Eucharist's focal point. If you have not thought clearly about the purpose in coming here, I would advise you to take us and leave.

spans.text: You are the key to this mission and Eucharist's focal point. If you have not thought clearly about the purpose in coming here, I would advise you to take us and leave.

units.rawText: Wait, Professor, if you...
units.displayText: Wait, Professor, if you...

spans.text: Wait, Professor, if you...

units.rawText: Yes, let's go for the other plan. Even if it is a tad bit late.
units.displayText: Yes, let's go for the other plan. Even if it is a tad bit late.

spans.text: Yes, let's go for the other plan. Even if it is a tad bit late.

units.rawText: Salmon.
units.displayText: Salmon.

spans.text: Salmon.

units.rawText: The white-clad person had begun a call at some unknown time.
units.displayText: The white-clad person had begun a call at some unknown time.

spans.text: The white-clad person had begun a call at some unknown time.

units.rawText: You're a sight for sore eyes... What, did it not go well?
units.displayText: You're a sight for sore eyes... What, did it not go well?

spans.text: You're a sight for sore eyes... What, did it not go well?

units.rawText: Yes, it looks like we'll have to opt for plan B. How's the situation on your end?
units.displayText: Yes, it looks like we'll have to opt for plan B. How's the situation on your end?

spans.text: Yes, it looks like we'll have to opt for plan B. How's the situation on your end?

units.rawText: So boring it'd make you want to puke is what it is. Can't the bugs visiting Arcadia be a bit stronger?
units.displayText: So boring it'd make you want to puke is what it is. Can't the bugs visiting Arcadia be a bit stronger?

spans.text: So boring it'd make you want to puke is what it is. Can't the bugs visiting Arcadia be a bit stronger?

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll adjusts their camera, explaining over a backdrop of the captured image.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll adjusts their camera, explaining over a backdrop of the captured image.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll adjusts their camera, explaining over a backdrop of the captured image.

units.rawText: Behind him, Entropic corpses yet to dissipate pile up in mountains as the cause of this scene licks at the remnant operands on a knife's edge, completely nonchalant.
units.displayText: Behind him, Entropic corpses yet to dissipate pile up in mountains as the cause of this scene licks at the remnant operands on a knife's edge, completely nonchalant.

spans.text: Behind him, Entropic corpses yet to dissipate pile up in mountains as the cause of this scene licks at the remnant operands on a knife's edge, completely nonchalant.
Good work.
That's not sanitary, you know?

units.rawText: Just putting away some boring stuff is all.
units.displayText: Just putting away some boring stuff is all.

spans.text: Just putting away some boring stuff is all.

units.rawText: A little bit of unease facilitates enjoyment, does it not?
units.displayText: A little bit of unease facilitates enjoyment, does it not?

spans.text: A little bit of unease facilitates enjoyment, does it not?

units.rawText: Shall I come pick you up? There's not very much time left.
units.displayText: Shall I come pick you up? There's not very much time left.

spans.text: Shall I come pick you up? There's not very much time left.

units.rawText: Yes, as quickly as you can.
units.displayText: Yes, as quickly as you can.

spans.text: Yes, as quickly as you can.

units.rawText: The white-robed human mutters in thought.
units.displayText: The white-robed human mutters in thought.

spans.text: The white-robed human mutters in thought.

units.rawText: If this operation fails, all of our previous plans will fall like dominoes and the state of things will become unsalvageable.
units.displayText: If this operation fails, all of our previous plans will fall like dominoes and the state of things will become unsalvageable.

spans.text: If this operation fails, all of our previous plans will fall like dominoes and the state of things will become unsalvageable.

units.rawText: The result will be complete Entropization of Magrasea. Eosphorus will have what he desires and be able to access the outside world.
units.displayText: The result will be complete Entropization of Magrasea. Eosphorus will have what he desires and be able to access the outside world.

spans.text: The result will be complete Entropization of Magrasea. Eosphorus will have what he desires and be able to access the outside world.

units.rawText: We must stop such a thing, Salmon...
units.displayText: We must stop such a thing, Salmon...

spans.text: We must stop such a thing, Salmon...

units.rawText: No need to change plans. We will continue.
units.displayText: No need to change plans. We will continue.

spans.text: No need to change plans. We will continue.

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier donned her usual smile after a deep breath.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier donned her usual smile after a deep breath.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier donned her usual smile after a deep breath.

units.rawText: Do not underestimate a Greater Sanctifier's resolve. Even if the foe is a former comrade, I shall not waver even for a moment.
units.displayText: Do not underestimate a Greater Sanctifier's resolve. Even if the foe is a former comrade, I shall not waver even for a moment.

spans.text: Do not underestimate a Greater Sanctifier's resolve. Even if the foe is a former comrade, I shall not waver even for a moment.

units.rawText: What is it?
units.displayText: What is it?

spans.text: What is it?

units.rawText: Nothing, just thought the look in your eyes was familiar. Makes me think of who I was in the past.
units.displayText: Nothing, just thought the look in your eyes was familiar. Makes me think of who I was in the past.

spans.text: Nothing, just thought the look in your eyes was familiar. Makes me think of who I was in the past.

units.rawText: The Professor said nothing else, merely patting Angelus on the shoulder, and standing side by side with her.
units.displayText: The Professor said nothing else, merely patting Angelus on the shoulder, and standing side by side with her.

spans.text: The Professor said nothing else, merely patting Angelus on the shoulder, and standing side by side with her.

units.rawText: The revelation that long-kept beliefs are based on lies is bound to break many...
units.displayText: The revelation that long-kept beliefs are based on lies is bound to break many...

spans.text: The revelation that long-kept beliefs are based on lies is bound to break many...

units.rawText: But do not forget what has kept you going all this time.
units.displayText: But do not forget what has kept you going all this time.

spans.text: But do not forget what has kept you going all this time.

units.rawText: ...Of course. I keep it in my heart in every moment.
units.displayText: ...Of course. I keep it in my heart in every moment.

spans.text: ...Of course. I keep it in my heart in every moment.

units.rawText: Thank you... Professor.
units.displayText: Thank you... Professor.

spans.text: Thank you... Professor.

units.rawText: Go thank the Professor if you must thank someone. I am merely imitating what I see from them.
units.displayText: Go thank the Professor if you must thank someone. I am merely imitating what I see from them.

spans.text: Go thank the Professor if you must thank someone. I am merely imitating what I see from them.

units.rawText: Yes... It would appear there is a need to offer thanks in person after the mission is over.
units.displayText: Yes... It would appear there is a need to offer thanks in person after the mission is over.

spans.text: Yes... It would appear there is a need to offer thanks in person after the mission is over.

units.rawText: ...That's how things are, Salmon. You can stay at Arcadia, no need to come over.
units.displayText: ...That's how things are, Salmon. You can stay at Arcadia, no need to come over.

spans.text: ...That's how things are, Salmon. You can stay at Arcadia, no need to come over.

units.rawText: Oi!
units.displayText: Oi!

spans.text: Oi!

units.rawText: The Professor cuts the call, leaving the incoming indignities and complaints on the other side of the screen.
units.displayText: The Professor cuts the call, leaving the incoming indignities and complaints on the other side of the screen.

spans.text: The Professor cuts the call, leaving the incoming indignities and complaints on the other side of the screen.

units.rawText: So, Antonina, how goes tracing the speaker?
units.displayText: So, Antonina, how goes tracing the speaker?

spans.text: So, Antonina, how goes tracing the speaker?

units.rawText: Eucharist is indeed waiting for us at the Pantheon.
units.displayText: Eucharist is indeed waiting for us at the Pantheon.

spans.text: Eucharist is indeed waiting for us at the Pantheon.

units.rawText: Looks like she knows what we're here for. We need to make there in good time.
units.displayText: Looks like she knows what we're here for. We need to make there in good time.

spans.text: Looks like she knows what we're here for. We need to make there in good time.

units.rawText: Hold on. There's some trouble to take care of.
units.displayText: Hold on. There's some trouble to take care of.

spans.text: Hold on. There's some trouble to take care of.

units.rawText: Before the Professor can move, Angelus fires a shot around a corner and an Entropic's cry of pain can be heard. Soon, an endless tide of Entropics appear around the corner.
units.displayText: Before the Professor can move, Angelus fires a shot around a corner and an Entropic's cry of pain can be heard. Soon, an endless tide of Entropics appear around the corner.

spans.text: Before the Professor can move, Angelus fires a shot around a corner and an Entropic's cry of pain can be heard. Soon, an endless tide of Entropics appear around the corner.

units.rawText: Tch, when did they get nestled in here?
units.displayText: Tch, when did they get nestled in here?

spans.text: Tch, when did they get nestled in here?

units.rawText: Some "gifts" left behind by Eucharist. Do not forget that I understand her as well as she understands me.
units.displayText: Some "gifts" left behind by Eucharist. Do not forget that I understand her as well as she understands me.

spans.text: Some "gifts" left behind by Eucharist. Do not forget that I understand her as well as she understands me.

units.rawText: It is time to punish some naughty children... Are you two ready?
units.displayText: It is time to punish some naughty children... Are you two ready?
